They are well-known for their ability to shift their style across a wide range of musical genres, from classical to pop and jazz. Jiří Pokorny's 'Words and Space' is a metaphor of an intrapersonal speech, a book full of floating stories. It is personal, intimate, and very poetic. 'Phoenix' is inspired by the idea of the infinite circular motion of life: Birth, growth, immobility,
